Neighbour Uncle and plumber Iroh are distinct. Bantu and Bobby are adult twins (22) with different responses.

Dhika's John-only intercourse boundary remains unless she makes an explicit, informed choice in future prose.

India callers never accidentally view private hotel scenes; phone calls connect legitimate logistical and social threads.
Return timeline must account for travel, jobs, family and existing story commitments before reunion encounters.
